My opinion is not very positive about this petrol pump and CNG station.
Everyone may have different opinions about the same place. So I would urge you to consider my experience as my personal feedback, and based on your sole experience, try to reach to a conclusion.
The major aspects, I considered are:
Location : 10/10
CNG Availability : 8/10
Service : 6/10
Genuineness : 6/10
Behavior : 3/10
Neatness : 3/10
Staff : 3/10
Queue : 4/10

This place is mostly crowded and always you may experience a long queue either for CNG or for Petrol and Diesel ⛽.

Now the next thing is staff behavior. Which is normally very rude with almost all the customers. You may often experience drunk staff at this station. And with drunken staff, it is difficult to expect genuine behavior.

Neatness is the third aspect which can be discussed separately. And at this level, this place deserves almost a negative review.
Try to use their washroom, you may experience vomiting 🤮🤢 . It is almost the same as any public toilet. The same situation is for a fuel refilling area. Considering its locality and crowd, it can be compared with a local garage.

Queues are another aspect which can be discussed separately. And in my opinion it is mostly because of mismanagement.

For petroleum and CNG, we all look for a local solution and this is the advantage for this place. It is open 24 x 7 for service.

But the management really needs to work seriously on above suggested points.

Thanks You.🙏

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is located in Andheri West near DN Nadar Metro station or we can call it apna bazaar market. Bunch of cheaters.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my dissatisfaction regarding a recent visit to your petrol pump.

Upon my arrival, I joined the queue and was asked by an attendant what fuel I wished to have filled. I clearly stated "Petrol." However, when it was finally my turn, I was informed that petrol was not available and only Power 95 was being dispensed.

This situation was very frustrating as I wasted valuable time waiting in line only to find out that the fuel I needed was not available. It would have been greatly appreciated if this information had been communicated earlier, allowing me to choose another petrol station without delay.

I hope you will take this feedback into consideration to improve the customer experience at your station.

🚨 Beware of the Air Pump Scam! 🚨
Next time you stop to fill air in your tyres, stay alert. A common trick is happening at some air pumps:

🔧 The man filling air will secretly loosen the tyre valve.
💨 Air slowly leaks out…
⚠️ Then he tells you, “tyre is punctured.”

Right beside the pump, another person (part of the same scam) will quickly offer to “fix” it and charge ₹200–₹300 to replace the valve — even though nothing was actually wrong.

🛑 How to protect yourself:
• Watch closely while air is being filled
• Check the valve yourself before agreeing to any repair
• Don’t rush into paying for “quick fixes”
• If possible, fill air yourself

👉 Stay alert. Share this post to help others avoid getting scammed!

Mr A. S. Sahney, Chairman, IndianOil, congratulates Team HPCL and HRRL on the successful commissioning of the HPCL Rajasthan Refinery Limited, describing it as a landmark achievement that strengthens India’s energy security, industrial self-reliance and refining capabilities.

Congratulations to HRRL on the commissioning of India’s first Greenfield Integrated Refinery-cum-Petrochemical Complex — a landmark achievement that strengthens India’s refining and petrochemical capabilities.

This milestone reflects the nation’s continued commitment to energy security, industrial growth, and building a future-ready energy ecosystem.

Wishing the entire HRRL team continued success as they contribute to powering India’s progress.

It has come to our attention that a notice regarding ethanol-blended petrol, purportedly bearing the logos of various Oil Marketing Companies, is circulating on social media. Please note that this is an old, unauthorized message that has been circulating for some time and does not reflect our official communications.

IndianOil supplies fuels strictly in accordance with IS 17021:2018 specifications and all applicable quality standards. E20 fuel is a homogeneous, scientifically validated product specifically designed for safe vehicular use. Although ethanol is naturally hygroscopic, modern vehicles are engineered with sealed fuel systems to prevent water ingress. 

The introduction of E20 petrol in India followed extensive testing and validation by automobile manufacturers and industry experts. Since its rollout, there have been no credible reports of engine failures or performance issues directly attributable to ethanol blending. E20 is safe for use in all compatible vehicles.

IndianOil strongly advises customers not to rely on or circulate unverified messages.
